summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Elastech Production (K-HTT, Copper Strip, Rating DKA). 11/11 pytest backend tests passed including CRUD across all 3 modules and Claude Sonnet 4.6 AI analysis. Frontend Playwright flow verified: landing page (Elastech + SaaS/IoT/Web App/Mobile App chips + 3 module cards), sidebar nav to all 3 modules, empty-form validation toast, sample creation, view detail dialog, AI analysis (Indonesian output with RINGKASAN section), 'Ready' badge, delete, and invalid-slug redirect to /.
